description: Analyze a stock for entry timing — "when should I buy X", "is now a good time", "what's actually driving X", "analyze X for entry/a position". Pulls live price and financials, separates the fundamental thesis from technical/supply factors (M&A share overhangs, lock-up expiries, secondary offerings, PE-sponsor distribution, index flows, rate/rotation pressure), maps the catalyst, earnings and seasonality calendar, locates the name in its 52-week cycle and on the recognized-vs-unrecognized spectrum, underwrites the financials and the people, and returns a concrete, tranched, date-stamped buy plan sized as a percent of the book. For a self-directed active sleeve, not a diversified retirement core.
